source_title: Python - Software Engineer at Saatvik Agro — Morena, Madhya Pradesh, India | LinkedIn Jobs - LinkedIn India
source_excerpt:
See who Saatvik Agro has hired for this role
Saatvik Agro is the agro-ingredient unit of the Saatvik Group, specializing in high-quality maize-based ingredients used in food, nutrition, animal feed, and industrial applications. The organization focuses on purity and scientific rigor, converting responsibly sourced maize into functional and reliable ingredient solutions. Its products are designed to meet the evolving needs of modern manufacturers who demand consistency, performance, and safety. Guided by the belief that better ingredients create better outcomes, Saatvik Agro aims to support customers in delivering superior products to their markets.
We are looking for a Python - Software Engineer for a full-time, on-site opportunity based in Morena, Madhya Pradesh, India.
The role is suitable for fresh graduates and technology professionals interested in Python software development, backend engineering, application development, APIs, automation, data processing, cloud technologies, databases, enterprise applications, and modern software-engineering practices.
The Python - Software Engineer will work closely with software, IT, data, analytics, operations, production, supply chain, finance, sales, and other business teams to develop, test, integrate, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve Python-based applications, backend services, APIs, automation tools, databases, internal platforms, enterprise systems, and digital solutions.
Depending on project requirements, the role may involve Python, Django, Flask, FastAPI, REST APIs, SQL and NoSQL databases, Pandas, NumPy, SQLAlchemy, microservices, cloud platforms, Git, Docker, testing frameworks, CI/CD, and other modern Python technologies.
B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. / BCA / MCA / M.Sc. / M.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Applications, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
Fresh graduates and experienced candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.
Candidates with 0–5 years of experience in Python development, software engineering, backend development, application development, API development, automation, data engineering, or related technology roles can apply.
Candidates currently working as Python - Software Engineer, Python Software Engineer, Software Engineer - Python, Software Engineer Python, Software Engineer (Python), Python Developer, Python Backend Developer, Backend Engineer, Backend Developer, Application Developer, Automation Engineer, Associate Software Engineer, Graduate Software Engineer, Junior Python Developer, or similar roles are encouraged to apply.
Candidates from IT services, SaaS, product companies, technology, consulting, e-commerce, fintech, telecom, analytics, manufacturing, logistics, FMCG, or other industries are welcome.
Basic to good knowledge of Python programming, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, functions, classes, modules, packages, exception handling, debugging, and clean coding practices.
Familiarity with Django, Flask, FastAPI, or similar Python backend and web-development frameworks will be beneficial.
Basic to good understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS, web services, authentication, authorization, API integration, and system integration.
Familiarity with SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, or similar relational and NoSQL databases will be beneficial.
Understanding of database design, normalization, joins, indexing, transactions, schemas, CRUD operations, queries, and basic query optimization will be advantageous.
Familiarity with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Requests, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, or similar libraries will be beneficial.
Exposure to automation, scripting, workflow automation, reporting, scheduled jobs, data extraction, data transformation, or process automation will be considered an advantage.
Exposure to ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, data cleaning, data validation, batch processing, or data-integration workflows will be beneficial but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with Git, GitHub, version control, branching, pull requests, code reviews, debugging, and collaborative software-development workflows.
Exposure to PyTest, unittest, Postman, unit testing, API testing, integration testing, or automated testing will be beneficial.
Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, or similar cloud and DevOps technologies will be beneficial.
Basic understanding of Linux, command-line tools, virtual environments, dependency management, application deployment, logging, monitoring, and production-support concepts will be advantageous.
Exposure to microservices, Celery, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, asynchronous processing, background jobs, caching, scheduled tasks, or messaging systems will be considered an advantage.
Familiarity with OAuth, JWT, role-based access control, secure coding, API security, authentication, authorization, encryption, and input-validation concepts will be beneficial.
Exposure to scalable backend applications, distributed systems, serverless applications, cloud functions, or event-driven architectures will be advantageous.
Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, generative AI, large language models, data science, or analytics using Python will be considered an additional advantage but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, dashboards, reporting systems, ERP, CRM, or enterprise applications will be beneficial but is not mandatory.
Exposure to frontend technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue.js, or Next.js will be beneficial but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, Jira, SDLC, user stories, technical documentation, requirements gathering, sprint planning, or issue tracking will be advantageous but is not mandatory.
Good analytical, logical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Good communication, documentation, teamwork, and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
Ability to understand business and technical requirements and translate them into practical, scalable, maintainable, reliable, and secure Python software solutions.
Willingness to work in an on-site environment.
Internship, academic project, Python project, backend project, API project, automation project, data project, database project, GitHub project, hackathon, freelance assignment, startup project, or open-source contribution will be considered but is not mandatory.
Candidates without previous full-time Python-development experience can also apply.
Strong willingness to learn new Python frameworks, libraries, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, automation tools, testing technologies, and modern software-engineering practices.
Industries Agricultural Chemical Manufacturing
